candidates.snippet:
Andy Burnham:

We want to see the suffering and death finally come to an end. We want to see Israeli and Palestinian people living side by side in peace and security. 

And we will do all we can to keep the hope of that possibility alive. https://t.co/BU3dwSmtU0

Andy Burnham on Israel:

We stand with Israel in the face of the ongoing threats, including from Iran, against Israel and Jewish people around the world.

But this does not justify the Israeli government's actions in Gaza or the West Bank. https://t.co/GWZUVmZN5Q

Andy Burnham:

We will stand firm in the face of any threats and challenges to the rule of law, not just from Russia, but from others, too, including where they threaten the rights of British territories to remain British, such as the Falkland Islands. https://t.co/pyzNox3zjJ
